asset_label: steel bridge element surface (coating and corrosion condition)
source_note: Native values are the four labels of the Corrosion Condition State Semantic Segmentation Dataset (Bianchi and Hebdon, Virginia Tech, CC0, figshare 16624663). Criteria are quoted verbatim from the dataset's Corrosion Annotation Guidelines (Eric Bianchi, September 2021), which follow the AASHTO Manual for Bridge Element Inspection (2018) and the FHWA Bridge Inspector's Reference Manual (2012). Unified mapping follows the MBEI condition-state row in docs/research/05_damage_grading_standards.md: CS1 S0, CS2 S1, CS3 S2, CS4 S3, with S4 reserved for CS4 plus instability indicators.

rows.criterion: 'Good' Rating: No visible corrosion / Minimal corrosion. All defect types with a condition better than 'Fair' condition state 2 (CS2) are considered 'Good' condition state 1 (CS1). Peeling paint is not annotated as corrosion.

Surface Corrosion: Corroded portions of steel that do not appear to be disintegrating are annotated as '2 - Fair'. Exposed Steel: Peeled paint that exposes and corrodes underlying steel is considered '2 - Fair'. Freckled Rust/Sporadic Corrosion: Corrosion that is clustered or scattered in a general region is annotated as a single mass of corrosion (typically '2 - Fair'). Streaked Corrosion: Corrosion that appears to be streaked or to discolor steel is annotated as 2 - Fair.
rows.reference_image_note: Fair CS-2: Freckled rust is present

rows.criterion: 'Poor' Rating: Corrosion that appears as deeper-than-surface corrosion or beginning to disintegrate portions of steel is considered '3 - Poor' (includes Pack Rust).
rows.reference_image_note: Poor CS-3: Pack-rust, section loss and corrosion

rows.criterion: 'Severe' Rating: Corrosion that seems to have disintegrated portions of steel and/or corrosion that seems to affect structural integrity of the bridge component is annotated as '4 - Severe'. Section Loss: Steel with complete section loss (holes or cavities) should be annotated as severe with surrounding areas annotated appropriately.
rows.reference_image_note: Severe CS-4: Multiple perforations, extreme section loss.

unified_note: Severe with visible instability, displacement or a bearing area compromised maps to S4 (escalate). Grade the worst condition visible in the crop; debris and rulers are not corrosion.

flags.section_loss: set on Poor and Severe (deeper-than-surface corrosion)
flags.not_measurable: set when a criterion needs a section-loss measurement you cannot make

measurement_note: percent_area_rusted may be estimated visually as the fraction of the crop showing rust; section_loss_pct requires thickness data and must be null unless provided.
